row.name: BlackRock Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=29 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.71 tightness=0.9 base_volume_vs_leg=0.79 base_volume_vs_avg=0.99
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 29 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.71 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 1.4% vs its 20-SMA, 0.3% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: Three independent measured failures — C (base 29 sessions, giveback 0.71 of the leg), RE (burst bar only 62% of the prior 5-bar range), and VOL (volume below prior session, below the 50-session average, and rank 57 of 60 with the catalyst-volume requirement triggered by the 29-session base) — combine with a visually declining, wide base that spent the entire leg gain. The shaded consolidation region on the chart shows price drifting from ~1150 down to ~1050, a clear downtrend rather than a tight sideways rest, with multiple wide overlapping bars and no orderly compression. This is not a burst out of a quiet base; it is a modest bounce inside a multi-week decline.
claude.key_risk: The base is a declining channel that gave back 71% of the prior leg, meaning any follow-through faces the full weight of overhead supply from the entire August–October range.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 1082.39 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace.
